summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026 regarding a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The Audit Committee dismissed YCM CPA INC. effective June 3, 2026 and simultaneously engaged Assentsure PAC as the new auditor. No disagreements or reportable events occurred during the prior two fiscal years or subsequent interim period. There were no adverse opinions, disclaimers, or modifications in YCM's reports. YCM agreed with the disclosures. This is a routine auditor change, not a special situation. No deal terms or special-situation characteristics are present.
